title: Velocity of A
description: Essential: The student must state that the speed of block A when it separates from the spring is 5 m/s.

title: Velocity of B
description: Essential: The student must state that the speed of block B when it separates from the spring is 5 m/s.

title: Spring Potential Energy
description: Essential: The student must calculate and state the initial elastic potential energy as 50 J.

title: A's Circular Motion Condition
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Newton's second law for circular motion at the highest point to find the minimum speed.

title: Energy Conservation for A
description: Important: The solution must apply conservation of mechanical energy from the launch point to the top of the semicircle for block A.

title: Momentum Conservation for B
description: Important: The solution must apply conservation of linear momentum to find the common velocity of block B and the plank.

title: Work-Energy for Sliding
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem or energy conservation to find the relative displacement or energy loss for block B on the plank.

title: Conclusion on Sliding Off
description: Important: The solution must correctly conclude, with reasoning, that block B slides off the plank because the required relative displacement exceeds the plank's length.

title: Internal Energy Calculation
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the internal energy generated (Q) as 10 J.

title: Sign or Unit Error
description: Pitfall: Deduct for sign errors in velocity directions, incorrect unit usage, or forgetting to square velocities in energy terms.

title: Friction Force Mistake
description: Pitfall: Deduct for using the wrong mass (e.g., M instead of m) in the kinetic friction force formula (μmg).
